integrity: Original arithmetic determination reconstructed from exact finite-field counts plus functional equation; no claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic conclusion for one explicit F3-model, not all twists; the Jacobian splitting is an isogeny, not a polarized isomorphism. Geometric automorphism and genus minimality are previously established; no independent validation has been performed.
title: Exact zeta function and elliptic splitting of a minimal genus-three Artin–Schreier curve
